protocol.order: Three blocks. Rotate the eight scenario/count groups between blocks; rotate five culling modes within each group. Repetition 1 reverses mode traversal.
protocol.timing: Median of three run medians; retain frames 241..1200; report the min/max of run medians, not a confidence interval.
protocol.capture: Separate validation-enabled runs capture the final framebuffer at application frame 1200 (20 simulated seconds). No screenshot layer or intermediate state readback during timing runs.
protocol.scope: Density changes in the same 15x15 field; all blades continue physical simulation; unchanged Stage 3 renderer.
protocol.limitations: Serialized Vulkan frame loop and profiling boundary; intervals may include waits within their GPU timestamp endpoints. Not end-to-end FPS. GPU clocks are not locked and desktop activity is not fully isolated. Final draw counts are endpoint counts, not time averages.
